name: Home services
description: Management transport and the explicitly tested media paths on the mini. Rehearse and canary before enforcing.

modules.name: Management (SSH, Tailscale)
modules.rationale: Owner management over the LAN and tailnet. Replies to permitted inbound connections must keep working without a blanket established-connection bypass.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: remote administration of the mini is lost; recover at the console.
modules.provenance: moat maintainers, tested on the reference mini 2026-10
test_recipe: ssh mini.local true  # from a LAN client, expect success
keep a console open; trial apply with a 5-minute rollback

modules.name: Plex media server
modules.rationale: Plex clients on the LAN; remote access through the tailnet. plex.tv sign-in is optional and separate.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: LAN clients cannot browse or stream.
test_recipe: play a title on a LAN TV for 2 minutes; expect no blocked incident
seek and resume; expect no new destinations

modules.name: BlueBubbles relay
modules.rationale: Message relay for the owner's phone over the tailnet.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: phone messaging through the mini stops.
test_recipe: send and receive one message from the phone over the tailnet
